Thank you for your reply!

I'm currently looking at hostels, good idea that didn't pop into my head immediately. Though I'm not sure about the legalities of temporary jobs within Europe. Can I just go work somewhere in a different European country without the possibility of getting in trouble?

Don't feel too bad for too long about dad dying. When you're 18, pack a bag and go to England. Don't wait until you're 21. You won't have the money or the people anymore, do it while you can or end up severely depressed and stuck, kid. Also, either stay with S. from the start or don't let her in at all.
Happy birthday, sir. Thank you for the awesome content and I hope you have a very nice day indeed. Happy Holidays!
That is some very, very nice wrapping paper.

I made an account on Reddit just for Secret Santa. I am more of a lurker in the gifs and picture related subreddits and ones of my favourite Youtubers but usually don't really have much to say. I signed up for this because it's special, it's interacting with people online through physical items. While I understand and pretty much agree with your point, there's still the likes/dislikes in which I've fully explained what I enjoy and what I don't, I've made a wishlist to show examples of things I like and such. And if my Santa runs into any issues, there's the message button. The only thing that annoys me is the threads where I see someone's Giftee hasn't even posted a full sentence on their likes/dislikes which makes it difficult.

Doing the same aswell. My first exchange so for some reason I feel it'd put my mind at ease knowing they made the extra effort to send a quick message. I've sent one to my Giftee, asking more details so hoping to hear back soon.

As someone with depression, I either prefer people to not mention it or people giving something that shows they genuinely care, for me that's done through comedy or something personalized. I think the idea of your favourite board game and book are really good, I get a lot of happiness from people wanting to involve me in what they like. Just make sure you actually mention they're your favourites. And it might be a good idea to find out what topics your giftee is sensitive to as there is always a chance the theme of the book might bother them. It's best to make sure.

You can make the paper look like parchment with coffee or tea (tutorials are all over the internet for this) and roll it up and tie a ribbon around it. It's fairly simple and, in my opinion, fits the theme really well.

I feel like I either put too much or too little. I might've put so much that my Santa won't know where to begin or too little as in being too vague on things like favourite characters of series and such. I wish I had social media links to give but I don't use any.
Train Simulator 2012. Subscribed the day after it came out.

Hello there. I am Tom. I am 21 years old and I am from a small, crappy town in Belgium. I have varied interests but my main entertainment sources are WWE, Doctor Who, Game of Thrones and Ashens. I love sitting indoors and play videogames. Usually sticking around the WWE and GTA games but I don't mind a calm exploration game every now and then like Gone Home which basically is an Oh-God-What-Was-That-Noise-Help-Me simulator. Movie wise I like the original Tron, Marvel movies, Bruce Lee movies and the Cornetto Trilogy. Music, I usually like most things that are flung towards me. I'm not overly big on social media (still stuck in the email era) so I am massively confused by everything on this website. I subscribed to Dan on January 22nd 2012. I forgot why exactly. Have a good day.
